title: Burkina Faso farm activity defaults (diesel, electricity, yield guides)
description: Screening-level diesel (L/ha/yr), grid electricity (kWh/ha/yr), and yield guides for Burkina Faso farms when the Equipment & Energy step has no measured fuel/electricity. Keyed by mechanization x irrigated, same schema as ghana_farm_activity_defaults.json. Built for this region, NOT copied from Ghana: pumping energy is derived from water volume, head and pump efficiency; yields are FAOSTAT national means. Uncertainty is wide (factor ~2); every row carries a pedigree. Never invent fertiliser rates here.

provenance.span: Rainfed smallholder cereals and cotton worked by hand or animal traction; screening 0 L diesel, 0 kWh.
Dry-season gardens watered by hand from wells: no diesel or grid energy.
Motor-pump dry-season vegetables: 6000 m3/ha x 10 m head, pumpset efficiency 0.15: hydraulic 164 kWh = 101 L/ha.
Cotton belt: animal traction is the common partial mechanisation; tractor hire is occasional. Screening 10 L/ha.
Pumped rice schemes (e.g. Sourou): 14000 m3/ha x 4 m, efficiency 0.25 = 57 L/ha, plus ~35 L/ha land preparation. Gravity schemes (Bagre) need no pumping: report 0 if so.
Tractor-based cereal and cotton production on ferruginous soils: screening 55 L/ha within the 40-80 L/ha mechanised band.
Mechanised pumped schemes: ~60 L/ha diesel pumping plus ~70 L/ha field operations. The grid rarely reaches irrigated perimeters, so pumping is diesel by default.

sources.note: Tier 1 activity-data approach; this table supplies activity amounts, not emission factors.
Burkina Faso CDN 2021-2025 (Oct 2021): irrigation projects (PARIIS-BF, PIRA-BF drip) and land restoration dominate the agriculture actions.

FAOSTAT (2025) Crops and livestock products (QCL), Yield (kg/ha), bulk Production_Crops_Livestock_E_Africa.csv dated 2025-12-23. Mean of 2021-2023; see the region's yield-guide file for flags and pedigree.

Pump energy = volume x 9.81 x head / 3.6e6 / efficiency (kWh); diesel L = hydraulic kWh / (efficiency x 10.75 kWh/L, 38.7 MJ/L). Efficiencies: small diesel pumpset 0.15, larger diesel 0.25, electric wire-to-water 0.6 (FAO Irrigation Water Management training manuals, pump efficiency ranges). Field-operation diesel uses the mechanised-cereal 40-80 L/ha band. Reviewer to confirm against national surveys.
